*[[19 BBY|19]] and [[18 BBY]] {{C|flashback story}} {{C|[[Star Wars: Kanan Book I: The Last Padawan|''Book I'']]}}<ref name="Date-19BBY-I">The flashback story in [[Kanan 1|''Kanan'' 1]]-[[Kanan 3|''Kanan'' 3]] takes place during and shortly after [[Order 66]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]].</ref><ref name="Date-18BBY">[[Kanan 6|''Kanan'' 6]] states that it had been fourteen [[Standard year|years]] since [[Kanan Jarrus]] had seen [[Gamut Key]]. As Kanan last saw Gamut Key in [[Kanan 4|''Kanan'' 4]], this comic must be set fourteen years prior to [[Kanan 6|''Kanan'' 6]]. ''Kanan'' 6 has the [[Ghost]] crew aware of [[Fulcrum]], meaning that it must also be set after "[[Gathering Forces]]". However, as [[Ezra Bridger]] does not yet have his [[Ezra Bridger's first lightsaber|lightsaber]], it must be set before "[[Path of the Jedi]]." "[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]" places "[[Empire Day]]" (which directly precedes "Gathering Forces") and "Path of the Jedi" in [[4 BBY]], meaning that ''Kanan'' 6 must also take place in 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. If ''Kanan'' 6 takes place in 4 BBY, and ''Kanan'' 4 takes place fourteen years prior, it must take place in [[18 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Kanan 5|''Kanan'' 5]] to [[18 BBY]].</ref>

'''''Star Wars: Kanan''''', originally titled '''''Star Wars: Kanan - The Last Padawan''''', is a [[canon]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series first released on [[April 1]], [[2015]]. It was published by [[Marvel Comics]] and centers on [[Kanan Jarrus]], one of the protagonists of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' TV series. The two arcs, [[Star Wars: Kanan Book I: The Last Padawan|''The Last Padawan'']] and [[Star Wars: Kanan Book II: First Blood|''First Blood'']] are written by [[Greg Weisman]] and penciled by [[Pepe Larraz]].<ref name="Marvel Panel">{{SW|url=news/swca-star-wars-comes-home-to-marvel-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: ''Star Wars'' Comes Home to Marvel Panel Liveblog}}</ref> ''The Last Padawan'' takes place during [[Order 66]], while ''First Blood'' depicts Kanan's first foray into the [[Clone Wars]]. The series concluded with the publication of [[Kanan 12|''Kanan'' 12]] on [[March 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="Weisman Confirms">{{Twitter|Greg_Weisman|status/676974154562826241|[[Greg Weisman]]|quote=I'm told it ends with 12. But #StarWarsKanan 9 is available tomorrow!|archivefile=File:Twitter_GregWeisman_StarWarsKananEnd12.jpg}}</ref> Parts of the comic series are contradicted by the [[2021]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Aftermath TBB">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref>
